packet_dag.terminal_condition: Audit evidence exists for required routes/viewports or screenshot/auth blocker is recorded with owner and exact next action.
packet_dag.handoff_target: UI implementation packets after screenshots and Definition of Ready; non-UI P0 packets may proceed independently.

title: Current-state visual audit for One Time CRM and portals

reasons: The packet requires screenshots at five viewport widths.
The packet asks for CRM, inbox, portals, shared shell, preview mode, mobile menu, and landing visual changes.
Current-state screenshots are mandatory before broad product UI implementation.
likely_external_provider_blockers: Authenticated actual Rabbi session may be required to capture parity screenshots.
Source screenshots are missing from the supplied attachment.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: Supply or regenerate required screenshots before UI implementation packets.

operator_intent_summary: Audit the current One Time CRM, portal, preview, mobile, and landing states before implementing screenshot-dependent UI changes.
raw_quotes: No screenshot means no UI proof without a blocker.
Definition of Done requires screenshot evidence and live smoke.

decisions_captured.decision: Required source screenshots are unavailable locally.

out_of_scope: No product UI implementation in this audit packet.
No external sends, provider writes, payments, access grants, DNS changes, uploads, or deploys.
No GHL runtime or external CRM writes.
No claims that UI issues are fixed without after screenshots and deployment/live-smoke proof.

known_blockers: The six screenshot files referenced by the packet are unavailable locally.
Authenticated browser state may be required for actual Rabbi and view-as screenshots.
current_state.baseline_summary: Audit started by verifying the source screenshot paths are missing and recording an exact blocker.

expanded_phrases.CRM: Audit list/detail, inbox, timeline, notes, tasks, source labels, read-only view-as states, contact selection, and mobile detail flow.
expanded_phrases.portal: Audit Family, Student, Classroom, Library, parent setup/reset, shared shell, role links, preview preservation, support boundaries, and mobile menu.
expanded_phrases.professional: Translate visual quality into VQ findings for contrast, hierarchy, spacing, action states, credibility, and mobile reflow.
expanded_phrases.clean: Identify alignment, text fit, card state, redundant navigation, and leaked internal/debug labels through screenshots.
expanded_phrases.working: Verify actions have real handlers or explicit read-only/preview/blocked states with visible owner, reason, and next action.
expanded_phrases.GHL-like: Audit first-party CRM pattern gaps only; no external CRM runtime is authorized.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: Audit first-party One Time CRM patterns only. No GHL, LeadConnector, or external CRM writes.

requirements.statement: Complete the current-state visual audit for One Time UI routes before broad UI implementation.
requirements.expected_result: Required route/state/viewport screenshots and VQ findings exist, or an exact screenshot/auth blocker is recorded.
acceptance_criteria: All required viewports are represented for each affected route/state or precisely blocked.
Findings use VQ defect codes and map to requirement IDs.
Browser/page content is treated as untrusted evidence.
Implementation packets are generated only after Definition of Ready passes.

criteria: Screenshot source or exact screenshot blocker is recorded.
Out-of-scope provider writes and GHL runtime are listed.
Implementation remains forbidden until audit findings are complete.

loading.how_to_enter_state: Load CRM route while data fetches.
loading.aria_semantic_expectation: Loading status is associated with main CRM region.
loading.accessibility_expectation: Loading state is readable and not color-only.
loading.test_smoke_assertion: Audit captures loading or explains why the state cannot be captured.

empty.how_to_enter_state: Open a scoped CRM state with no matching records.
empty.expected_visible_message: No contacts match the current scope.
empty.aria_semantic_expectation: Empty state has a heading and message.
empty.accessibility_expectation: Empty state copy has WCAG AA contrast.
empty.test_smoke_assertion: Empty state distinguishes no records from loading/error.

populated.expected_visible_message: Scoped contacts are visible without unrelated workspace data.
populated.aria_semantic_expectation: List and detail regions are labeled.
populated.accessibility_expectation: Cards and text meet contrast and reflow requirements.
populated.test_smoke_assertion: Audit records row count, visible source labels, and first-page scope.

filtered_empty.how_to_enter_state: Apply a filter that has no matches.
forbidden_content: global workspace filter switch for Rabbi
filtered_empty.aria_semantic_expectation: Result count is conveyed in text.
filtered_empty.test_smoke_assertion: Filtered empty state is captured or blocked.

error.how_to_enter_state: Simulate or observe CRM API failure.
error.aria_semantic_expectation: Error has a heading and recovery action.
error.test_smoke_assertion: Error state is captured or blocked.

blocked_setup.how_to_enter_state: Open write control in read-only view-as mode.
blocked_setup.accessibility_expectation: Disabled state is conveyed in text.
blocked_setup.test_smoke_assertion: Read-only mutation controls are captured as disabled.

preview_only.expected_visible_message: TEST PREVIEW - SAMPLE DATA - NO WRITES
preview_only.aria_semantic_expectation: Preview banner is in page structure.

success_readback.how_to_enter_state: Open landing with WhatsApp launcher configured or blocked.
success_readback.expected_primary_action: Chat with One Time on WhatsApp.
success_readback.accessibility_expectation: Launcher has focus state and safe-area spacing.

permission_denied.how_to_enter_state: Open One Time CRM with wrong scope.
permission_denied.expected_visible_message: You do not have access to this workspace.
permission_denied.accessibility_expectation: Focus moves to denial or safe fallback.

mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.expected_visible_message: Selected contact detail is visible with a back action.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.aria_semantic_expectation: Detail view has heading and back control.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.accessibility_expectation: Touch targets and focus order are usable at 390px.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.test_smoke_assertion: Mobile detail state is captured or blocked.

findings.user_impact: Current-state visual findings cannot be verified because required screenshots are unavailable.
findings.expected_fix: Supply or regenerate screenshots, then map VQ findings to implementation packets.

accessibility.baseline: WCAG 2.2 A/AA plus BNA mobile reflow and focus requirements.

action_states.label: Run current-state screenshot audit
action_states.owner: Operator / Codex with authenticated browser access
action_states.handler_or_blocker: Source screenshots are missing; authenticated regeneration may be required.

action_states.label: Start screenshot-dependent UI implementation
action_states.handler_or_blocker: Blocked until this audit produces route/state findings and Definition of Ready passes.

scope_rules: Screenshots must not expose signed view-as tokens, raw private contact exports, secrets, or raw private message bodies.
Audit cannot approve sends, provider writes, payments, access grants, or deployment by itself.

instructions: Record VQ findings and state matrix gaps.
Map findings to requirement IDs and proposed child implementation packets.
Keep provider writes, sends, payments, and deploys out of scope.

context_budget.split_threshold_reason: Audit covers many routes, but implementation must be split by surface.

tests.expected_result: Visual audit packet validates as blocked, not implementation-ready.

tests.command_or_check: manual/file check for six source screenshot paths
tests.expected_result: Missing screenshot blocker is recorded until images are supplied or regenerated.

criteria: Required screenshots exist for the route/state/viewport matrix or exact blockers are recorded.
VQ findings map to requirement IDs.
Implementation packet proposals are scoped by surface.
No product code was changed by the audit packet.
Definition of Ready status for downstream UI packets is explicit.

tool_actions_expected: capture or ingest screenshots when available
trace.skipped_actions_policy: Skip product code edits, deploys, external sends, payments, uploads, access grants, DNS/provider mutations, and GHL runtime in this packet.

drift_watchdog.expected_result: No broad UI implementation packet proceeds without current-state screenshot evidence or exact blocker.

next_packet.description: After screenshots are available, generate focused UI implementation packets; until then continue non-screenshot identity and CRM isolation packets.
